label: Extended Deloria’s critique of settler science to DNA politics and genomics
description: Building on Deloria’s challenge to Western scientific authority over Native identity, TallBear exposed how DNA testing commodifies Indigenous belonging into racial biology.
dialecticalTension: Shifts Indigenous philosophy of science from archaeology to molecular genomics.

label: Aligned Indigenous relationality with multispecies kinship beyond settler property
description: Alongside Kimmerer’s animate ecological kinship, TallBear theorizes "making kin" across human and more-than-human worlds against settler-colonial extraction.
dialecticalTension: Weaves Dakota/Anishinaabe relational ontologies across STS and ecology.
